# leptonica / boxfunc5_fuzzer

leptonica's own fuzz target `boxfunc5_fuzzer` ([source](source/boxfunc5_fuzzer.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over leptonica (DanBloomberg/leptonica at 10bdea2f).

boxaReadMem, then boxaReconcileAllByMedian, boxaReconcileSidesByMedian, boxaReconcilePairWidth, boxaSizeConsistency, boxaSizeVariation, boxaSmoothSequenceMedian; results discarded.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against leptonica at commit 10bdea2f.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing. Its halts statements say only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer. Its agreement statements say only that the code never crashes or trips a sanitizer, and allow a run that never ends.

| `asan_agrees` | on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding 2 GiB (a premise): neither build reaches an error and both have the same set of observable behaviours; ASan never fires | open |
